variants.name: Live signal: KLCI, ringgit, MGS 10Y trend, MGS–UST spread
US 10Y trend in place of the MGS trend
Korea-style rotation (KLCI inverted: stocks down = bonds up)

ust.method: Overnight = New York closes strictly before each Kuala Lumpur close (New York shuts at about 04:00–05:00 Kuala Lumpur). Hedged = MGS 10Y minus β × US 10Y, β the trailing 26-week weekly beta known at the time. All variants walk-forward, z-scores vs trailing 52 weeks, thresholds ±0.5, hit rates over the next 4 weeks. The 'Beta 3Y' slot carries the MGS 15Y.

src: Yahoo Finance: FTSE Bursa Malaysia KLCI (^KLSE) and USD/MYR (MYR=X) daily closes; any USD/MYR close more than 1.5% from BNM’s KL USD/MYR reference rate is replaced by it. MGS 10Y and 15Y: BNM FAST consolidated indicative yield-to-maturity. US Treasury daily par yields (2Y, 10Y; home.treasury.gov). Weekly, last trading day of each week.

method.window: 4-week changes; z-scores vs trailing 52 weeks (min 26); thresholds ±0.5
components: USD/MYR 4-week % change (inverted: a weaker ringgit is bond-bearish)
MGS − UST 10Y spread vs its 26-week average (wide = cheap)

method.window: 20-day changes; z-scores vs trailing 260 sessions (min 130); spread vs its 130-day average; thresholds ±0.5; hit rates over the next 20 sessions; UST hedge β = trailing 130-day daily beta
components: MGS − UST 10Y spread vs its 130-day average (wide = cheap)
